title: zeroknowledger badge
description: What a verifier records after checking a proof. Enough for anyone to decide whether to accept it: which exact method version made it (by content hash, so the registry can later flag it if that version is revoked), what it disclosed, and when.

sha256.description: Hash of the method version (see registry/index.json).

disclosed.description: Keyed by the method's disclose.output, e.g. { "recipient_domain": "corp.com" }.

nullifier.description: Present when the method has one. Keep private server-side when the underlying identifier is guessable.

ref.description: Where the proof itself is stored, if it is kept.
